clue.text: Constituent seen in motorcar

parts.note: a car is built from many parts, and any one of them, from a piston to a wing mirror, is something seen as a piece of the whole

explanation.definitionFit: A constituent is one part that goes to make up a larger whole, such as a part of a car.

clue.text: Quite pleased about batting, though self-restrained

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other here, wrapping it

parts.note: quite pleased means content, satisfied
in cricket the side batting is in

explanation.surface: A batsman is happy enough at the crease, though keeping his feelings in check.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the containment signal; 'batting' is cricket, where the side currently at the crease is said to be in.
explanation.definitionFit: Continent in its older sense means showing self-control, especially over appetites.

clue.text: Seeing nothing in a boggy area's watery appearance

indicators.note: in places the letter for nothing within the word for the bog

parts.note: a mire is a boggy area
nothing is zero, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone looks at a marsh and sees nothing but a wet sheen.
explanation.definitionFit: Moire is a fabric or finish with a rippled, water-like sheen.

clue.text: To repeat : organise some light entertainment

indicators.note: organise tells us to arrange these letters into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to do something again, then lay on a little light amusement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organise' rearranges the letters of TO REPEAT.
explanation.definitionFit: An operetta is a short, light opera with spoken dialogue, a form of light entertainment.

clue.text: Regular number for the service

parts.note: regular, as in steady or uniform, means even
a number is a piece of music, a song

explanation.surface: A hymn sung regularly at a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'number' is a song in a show, not a figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Evensong is the evening prayer service of the Church of England.

clue.text: Check over the monarch's canopy

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: to check something is to test it
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the monarch's royal cipher

explanation.surface: An inspection of the canopy over a royal throne or bed.
explanation.walkthrough: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: A tester is a canopy over a four-poster bed or a pulpit.

clue.text: In favour of writing classes

parts.note: in favour of means for, supporting
MS is short for manuscript, a piece of writing

explanation.surface: Someone backs the idea of teaching writing in school classes.
explanation.walkthrough: MS is the standard abbreviation for manuscript.
explanation.definitionFit: Forms are school classes, as in sixth form in British schools.

clue.text: A producer at one time

explanation.surface: A film producer from years gone by.
explanation.definitionFit: A former is something that shapes or produces; former also means earlier, of a time past.

clue.text: Unprincipled professional person cutting discount

indicators.note: cutting means one piece slices into the middle of the other

parts.note: a rebate is a discount or reduction
a pro is a professional

explanation.surface: A shady professional slicing into a price discount.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting' is the containment signal: the professional slices the discount word in two, after its second letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A reprobate is an unprincipled person; the word also serves as an adjective meaning morally corrupt.

clue.text: A screen riddle

explanation.surface: A two-word puzzle about a screen.
explanation.definitionFit: A screen used to separate coarse from fine material is a mesh strainer; a riddle is also a coarse strainer for soil or gravel.

clue.text: Finding ways around good doctor's ingenuousness

annotationWithheld.why: Finding ways around good doctor's ingenuousness (7): VET for doctor is plain, but no reading of Finding ways around good gives the remaining NAIE, and the scan matches the text
annotationWithheld.clue: Finding ways around good doctor's ingenuousness

clue.text: A light-weight has reason to hesitate

explanation.surface: A slender person has second thoughts.
explanation.definitionFit: A scruple is an old apothecaries' weight of twenty grains, tiny indeed; it is also a moral doubt that holds one back.

clue.text: The woman in chic attire never looks out of place

indicators.note: in shows the name sits inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A stylish woman whose smart clothes always suit the occasion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points to the letters inside chic attIRE NEver; 'looks out of place' completes the picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Irene is a woman's name, so it stands for a particular female.

clue.text: A docker devotes break to the engineers

indicators.note: break means the letters of the word devotes are smashed and reassembled

parts.note: RE stands for Royal Engineers, the British Army corps

explanation.surface: A dock worker gives up his work break for the army engineers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' rearranges DEVOTES into STEVEDO; RE is the Royal Engineers.
explanation.definitionFit: A stevedore is a worker who loads and unloads ships, a docker.

clue.text: Once working this is critical

parts.note: ex means former, once
acting means working or functioning, as in an acting manager

explanation.surface: Something that was once in operation is now in a crucial state.
explanation.definitionFit: Exacting means demanding and severe, as a critical judge or standard is.

clue.text: Love giving a lecture after a little notice

indicators.note: in a down clue after means the lecture follows the notice

parts.note: an ad, short for advertisement, is a small notice
an oration is a formal speech or lecture

explanation.surface: Romance sparked by a speech given at short notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'little notice' suggests short notice, but it is AD, a small advertisement.
explanation.definitionFit: Adoration is deep love and worship.

clue.text: Hot music that grows on one

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps
an air is a tune, a piece of music

explanation.surface: Lively music that becomes more appealing over time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grows on one' looks like the idiom for liking something more over time; it is literal, something growing on a person.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair is what grows on the human head and body, so it literally grows on one.

clue.text: Vibration effects seen on car repair

indicators.note: repair means the letters of seen on car are mended into a new order

explanation.surface: Rattles noticed in a car after it has been repaired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'repair' rearranges SEEN ON CAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Resonance is the reinforcement of sound or motion by sympathetic vibration.

clue.text: The man to deal with the underworld problem?

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and the underworld itself
a poser is a puzzling problem

explanation.surface: Who can tackle the problem of organised crime?
explanation.walkthrough: Dis is the classical underworld, not gangland.
explanation.definitionFit: A disposer is someone who deals with or settles matters, arranging their outcome.

clue.text: Lacking transport, about a quarter appear unconcerned

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes round the second

parts.note: carless means without a car
E for east is one of the four quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: Without a car and fifteen minutes late, someone seems not to mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts E, a compass quarter, inside CARLESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Careless means heedless and indifferent, not worried about things.

clue.text: Sound, though possibly regressive

indicators.note: regressive suggests going backwards, and the word reads the same that way round

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A noise that might go backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly regressive' says the word is the same written backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A toot is a short blast of a horn, a sound.

clue.text: Some are prostrated following a call from them

definitions.text: Some are prostrated following a call from them

parts.words: Some are prostrated following a call from them
parts.note: the call is to prayer, given from mosque towers, after which worshippers bow to the ground

explanation.definitionFit: Minarets are mosque towers from which the muezzin calls the faithful to prayer.

clue.text: Way-out English king — a character

parts.note: GR is Georgius Rex, King George
ess is the spelt name of the letter S, a character

explanation.surface: An eccentric English king who was quite a character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Way-out' looks like slang for eccentric; read it as a way out, an exit.
explanation.definitionFit: Egress is a means of leaving, an exit.

clue.text: Difficult tricks set up with some object

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means the word is turned to read upwards

parts.note: arts are wiles or tricks
it is a pronoun for some object

explanation.surface: Tricky conjuring tricks arranged with a prop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns ARTS to STRA in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Strait as an adjective means narrow or hard, as in straitened circumstances.

clue.text: A butterfly can make a poet grin fatuously

indicators.note: fatuously suggests foolish disorder, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A butterfly is so pretty it could make a poet smile foolishly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fatuously' rearranges A POET GRIN.
explanation.definitionFit: The orange-tip is a white European butterfly whose male has orange wing tips.

clue.text: He'll show due regard for outstanding performance

definitions.text: He'll show due regard for outstanding performance

parts.words: He'll show due regard for outstanding performance
parts.note: the he is a gold statuette handed out as recognition of the year's finest film acting

explanation.definitionFit: An Oscar is the Academy Award statuette, given to honour outstanding film work.

clue.text: The Spanish type of drink still produced in Scotland

parts.note: el is the Spanish word for the
gin is a kind of spirit

explanation.surface: A Spanish sort of drink that is still made in Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'still' is not an adverb but a distillery still.
explanation.definitionFit: Elgin is a Moray town on Speyside, a centre of Scotch whisky distilling.

clue.text: Gout's bad for the appetite

indicators.note: bad means the letters of the word gout are spoiled into a new order

explanation.surface: Gout harms one's appetite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges GOUTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Gusto is hearty enjoyment and relish, as of food.

clue.text: Accord the artist an idle fancy

parts.note: to chime is to agree, to accord
RA is Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: Give the painter a passing fantasy.
explanation.walkthrough: RA is a Royal Academician.
explanation.definitionFit: A chimera is a fanciful illusion or wild dream.

clue.text: Boards another's offspring

explanation.surface: Lodgings for someone else's child.
explanation.definitionFit: To board a vehicle is to step on it; a child of one's spouse by a previous partner is another's offspring.

clue.text: Splits the hiring charges

explanation.surface: Sharing out the cost of hire.
explanation.definitionFit: Rents are tears or splits; rents are also payments for the use of property.

clue.text: Goes by the timbre to identify the bird

parts.note: turns means goes, as in it's your go or turn
tone is the quality or timbre of a sound

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher identifies a species by its song.
explanation.definitionFit: The turnstone is a small wading bird that flips stones looking for food.
